notes.title: ver1.2　Addition of some functions and correction of defects
notes.notes:
Update ver1.2.

[b]・Camera zoom function added[/b]
- Zoom function with mouse wheel added.

[b]・Additional tutorials[/b]
- Added tutorials on time stop and double speed functions to the tutorial at first startup.

[b]・Fixing Bug[/b]
- Fixed a bug in which the gauge is initialized when Continue is performed.
- Fixed a bug that caused freezing when Continue was performed after collapse
- Fixed a bug that records are initialized

notes.title: Some UI changes and bug fixes
notes.notes: Added and modified the UI to make the game content easier to understand, and fixed some bugs.
